entityDescription:
Robco was founded in 2020 and builds on the research results of more than 7 years at the Chair of Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Real-Time Systems at TU Munich. The company manufactures and sells end-to-end robot automation solutions for industrial SMBs with a unique, patented technology: a modular robot kit and software platform allowing for rapid deployment, flexible usage, cloud-connectivity and happy customers. Robco offers compelling economics for customers, with a return on investment for customers of within just 30 days through a Robot-as-a-Service rental model and attractive gross margins for Robco, enabled by a lean manufacturing setup. 
The project started with a robot manipulator concept and eventually turned into an end-to-end automation solution, conceptualised around the modular solution, which is globally the first of its kind. It exploits its advantages in terms of flexibility, scalability, repairability as well as ease of use. The advantages of an end-to-end offering become evident in comparison with the status quo, where customers experience long communication times, lacking adaptability and irregular updates as integrators are in the way between customer and manufacturer. 
Robcos vision is to make industrial robots as versatile as a tool. Companies are offered the possibility to automate their production intuitively, simply, flexibly and tailor-made with our robot kits and thus be accompanied by Robco in the transformation to Industry 4.0.
Robcos user interface is self-programming, based on CAD models or lidar scans. True IoT connectivity of the solution allows for cloud-based analytics and interfaces to enable productivity tracking. The resulting possibility for over-the-air-services diminishes capital-intensive field teams as required in robotics’ status quo. Downtime is reduced thanks to predictive maintenance features. 
Within the first year of commercialization, Robco has sold approx. 60 Robots across three continents and raised a Series A financing round, led by Sequoia Capital.

EnSilica (LON:ENSI) is a designer and supplier of RF, mixed signal and digital ASICs (Application Specific Integrated Circuit). EnSilica has proven expertise in developing complex ASICs including RF and mmWave, high speed serial interfaces and digital beamforming/baseband processing function. EnSilica is an Arm Approved design partner. EnSilica’s customers currently range from global corporations and OEMs to technology start-ups, including automotive Tier 1s, industrial enterprises, as well as large software companies and service providers developing proprietary hardware. EnSilica is an approved supplier to some of the world’s largest automotive and industrial OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers.
The company has expertise and IP relating to RF and mmWave in digital and hybrid beamforming and baseband processing for both payloads and user terminals using advanced node ASICs. RF experience ranges sub-GHz band, 5G FR1 bands and Ku and Ka-band bands. 
 The company has over 160 staff it is headquartered near Oxford, UK and has design centres across the UK and in India and Brazil.

GNSS Academy offers INDUSTRIAL TRAINING ON GNSS and SPACE ENGINEERING.

The GNSS Academy supports the GNSS Market from its main asset: Engineers, building the E2C path between Engineers seeking new job opportunities and the reference Companies demanding qualified profiles, through this JSNP training Program.

GNSS Academy offers engineers either still students or more experienced engineers from other sectors to boost their careers on the space industry and apply to the different open vacancies in companies looking for qualified engineers.

Our keep programme is so-called JSNP™, a 6-months Industrial Traineeship Program on Space GNSS. It covers all concepts from the basics to the most advanced concepts in PNT Satellite Navigation positioning, plus multiple resources.

it includes hands-on experiences with to the development of an end-to-end project in Python following the European Space Projects Standards from the requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, coding and validation phases.

So far, 6 Editions, 200 engineers from 28 different countries all over the World and multiple engineering backgrounds have already successfully accomplished this traineeship, now working on key companies on the Space and SatNav related sector.

entityDescription:
Inside Climate Service s.r.l. (ICS) is a limited liability company, an innovative start-up and spin-off of the University of Padova, incorporated in June 2021. ICS’s mission is to provide climate services for industry, agriculture and the tertiary sector. ICS develops cutting edge climate services for the public and commercial users. The primary goal is to raise awareness about the use of climate data for all sectors of society (education, energy, agriculture, tourism, etc.) through climate services that provide robust data and information and offer outstanding user interface and experience.
Tapping on some of the best climate scientists, software developers, designers, sector specialists and communicators, ICS aims to position itself as one of the global leading providers of visually-based climate services. ICS is developing around the industry pillars (particularly energy, water, agriculture, forestry), with strong focus on delivery robust and trustworthy data-based services to industry experts. 
Inside Climate Service is a spin-off of the University of Padova (https://www.unipd.it) and World Energy & Meteorology Council (WEMC, https://www.wemcouncil.org). The innovative nature of Inside Climate Service stems from a blend of Academia and operational developments.
It builds on the multi-decade experience and know-how developed in the Department of Land, Environment, Agriculture and Forestry of the University of Padova (https://www.tesaf.unipd.it) and at WEMC, also through the support of, and participation in, several world-leading EU projects such as the H2020, The Added Value of Seasonal Climate Forecasting for Integrated Risk Assessment (SECLI-FIRM, https://www.secli-firm.eu) and the award-winning Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) Climate and Energy Education Demonstrator (https://edudemo.climate.copernicus.eu) and its successor the TEAL tool (https://tealtool.earth).
More specifically, the expertise accrued by WEMC as coordinator of the C3S Energy operational service (https://climate.copernicus.eu/operational-service-energy-sector) carries through to ICS via its CEO, who is also the director of WEMC, as well as the close collaboration between ICS and WEMC staff. ICS is currently leading the development of the Enhanced Operational Service for the Energy Sector for C3S (https://climate.copernicus.eu/c3s2412-enhanced-operational-services-energy-sector).
Website address: https://www.inclimateservice.com/

entityDescription:
Our team is made up of mechanical engineers, professionals who are driven by engineering curiosity and motivated by the desire to use their experience to successfully solve technical problems and bring them to application.
Strength analysis:
We specialize in the strength analysis of machines and machine structures for static and cyclic loads as well as dynamic conditions. Our calculations are based on proven numerical simulations, which are verified by experimental investigation of material properties and structural level behaviour as required. A part of our job is to verify the compliance with standards of the analysed structures and to document the results in a credible way to our partner and the inspection authority.
Mechanical engineering development:
The safe operation of industrial equipment and machinery in general is determined by the interaction of its mechanical, thermal, fluid and electromagnetic subsystems and behaviour. Analysing such complex mechanisms of action analytically is not a viable practice. Therefore, numerical simulations are used to effectively predict the behaviour of the machine structure under operation conditions. In contrast to the experimental development method, simulations allow us to predict the behaviour of the structure under operating conditions from the beginning of the design phase. This means that the necessary development steps can be taken at an early stage, reducing development time and costs, which gives our partners a competitive advantage in the market.
Reliable background:
By correctly choosing and professionally carrying out and evaluating the proper numerical simulations for a given engineering development, we ensure that the project goals are achieved in the most efficient way. Our experts work in a supportive team environment, combining their experience and avoiding the usual development dead-ends. We use the most prevalent software tools (ANSYS, Altair HyperWorks, Code Aster, OpenFoam) for the given engineering problem, combined with automated modelling and evaluation techniques to ensure reliable results, particularly in short timeframes. We are active members of NAFEMS, the international non-profit organisation for simulation engineers, and our experts regularly participate in conferences as speakers,and in training courses. We also take care to ensure that the expertise of our engineers is constantly growing and they remain competitive.

Lenus Media is a development agency based in Italy, specializing in news production and scientific research dissemination. The company focuses on leveraging digital solutions to enhance the effectiveness of newspapers in delivering information related to digital marketing, life sciences, and tourism. By utilizing advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI) and database analysis, Lenus Media aims to create better and more accurate information for their audience.
One of the primary objectives of Lenus Media is to improve the efficacy of newspapers in presenting results pertaining to various fields, including digital marketing. By employing AI algorithms and data analysis techniques, the agency assists newspapers in deciphering complex marketing trends, identifying target audiences, and developing strategies to optimize digital marketing campaigns. This enables newspapers to deliver more relevant and engaging content to their readers, thereby increasing their overall effectiveness in the digital realm.
In addition to digital marketing, Lenus Media also focuses on enhancing the dissemination of scientific research, particularly in the life sciences field. The company recognizes the importance of scientific advancements and their impact on society. Through the utilization of AI algorithms and database analysis, Lenus Media collaborates with research institutions and scientific communities to distill complex research findings into comprehensible and accessible formats. This approach enables the agency to effectively bridge the gap between scientific discoveries and public understanding, ensuring that the latest advancements in life sciences are effectively communicated to a broader audience.
Lenus Media employs its digital solutions to enhance the tourism sector. By utilizing AI algorithms and data analysis, the agency assists newspapers and other media outlets in providing accurate and up-to-date information about popular tourist destinations, attractions, and experiences.

description: Cubicure GmbH pioneers materials, equipment, and processes for polymer additive manufacturing. Their Hot Lithography-based Caligma® and Cerion® 3D printing systems produce resilient precision components for extreme environments on an industrial scale. This production process eases the construction of highly complex apparatus by reducing lead times and minimizing the need for assembly. Flame-retardant photopolymers such as Cubicure’s ThermoBlast material build the basis for space applications. Tests have shown that this Hot Lithography material is stable within a temperature range between 150 °C and 300 °C. It also passes the thermal vacuum outgassing test for space materials according to ECSS-Q-70-02. Components produced via Hot Lithography can be coated with metals such as copper or silver. Especially lightweight metalized parts will help reduce payload weight in spacecraft such as satellites.
entityDescription:
Cubicure GmbH was founded in March 2015 as a spin-off of the TU Wien by Prof. Dr. Jürgen Stampfl (Institute of Material Science and Technology) and Dr. Robert Gmeiner. The company deals with the additive manufacturing of high performance polymers for industrial applications. Here, stereolithography (SLA) is used where light-curable plastics are cured with a laser in a layer-by-layer approach in outstanding precision. Cubicure develops photopolymers of which the properties are like those of technical thermoplasts.

Since 2017 Cubicure offers a specially developed and patented 3D-printing facility and associated materials in the market. The aim of Cubicure GmbH is the creation of products of highest quality for an industrial production environment.

entityDescription:
Technopolis Consulting Group Belgium is an independent research and consulting company with almost 20 years of experience in project management at European and international level. Its highly qualified staff of 40+people works in the fields of governance, research and business. Technopolis Consulting Group Belgium delivers its activities and services with the goal to tackle the widest range possible of environmental and societal challenges, thus enhancing economic growth and supporting the development of science, technology, and innovation.
Technopolis Consulting Group Belgium provides support in a wide range of areas:
- Digital Economy and Advanced technologies
- Research policy
- Entrepreneurship & enterprise policy, clusters and business sector analysis
- Regional and national innovation performance and policy
- Green economy and eco-innovation
- Open science
Our services include:
- Evaluations of government science, technology and innovation policies and programmes
- Strategic advice to policymakers, research organisations and public-private partnerships (PPP), including support to planning and forecasting
- Participation in the implementation and management of R&D and innovation programmes
- Comparative analyses of innovation systems, policies and strategies across countries and organisations
- Policy monitoring and policy learning
- Background studies and position papers on policies in the knowledge triangle
In this context, Technopolis has built a decade-long experience in network and capacity-building services, connecting research, policy and innovation stakeholders, to coordinating and disseminating research results, serving as a reference organisation to the research community.
